annotations.title: ROAD Act: purchases into covered investor groups

description: The purchase stream and agency case queue: recorded deeds (last sale per parcel, county rolls) into 350+ home groups, newest first. queue=true returns the enforcement queue (covered groups since July 11 2026, lender entities removed, market purchases with no build-to-rent signal first, same-day bulk restructurings last; nothing before Jan 7 2027 is a violation). Filters: group, county, status, since (YYYY-MM-DD), signal (NEW_CONSTRUCTION, BTR_COMMUNITY, BUYER_ENTITY_UNDER_350, GROUP_HIDDEN_FROM_NAME_SEARCH, LENDER_SERVICER_ENTITY, BULK_SAME_DAY_TRANSFER = 5+ deeds to one buyer on one date, likely affiliate restructuring, ROLL_DATE_FIRST_OF_MONTH), vehicles=true for Texas registry vehicles at covered groups' offices. Up to 200 rows. Free.
name: road_purchase_stream
